delivery.q: How long does a PUBG UC top-up take?
delivery.a: Top-ups are instant once payment is confirmed — usually within minutes. If it is delayed, message us on WhatsApp with your order code.

efootball.q: How do I receive an eFootball account?
efootball.a: Once your order is accepted we send the login details on WhatsApp. Each account is unique and sold only once.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a:
Worldwide: PayPal, credit cards, USDT and Binance Pay.
Inside Somalia: EVC Plus, JEEB, E-Dahab, ZAAD, SAHAL and WAAFI.

track.q: How do I track my order?
track.a: Keep the order code shown after confirmation (like M-123456) and send it to us on WhatsApp to check the status.

refund.a: Yes — if we cannot fulfil your order we refund the full amount. Delivered digital goods are non-refundable.

policy.title: Policies
policy.note: Terms of dealing with the store

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
By using Ramaan Store you agree to provide accurate details when ordering.
Prices may change without prior notice.
We reserve the right to refuse any suspicious order.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
We collect only what we need to fulfil your order: name, contact number and game account details.
We never sell your data or share it with third parties.
Game account details are used to fulfil the order only, then stored securely.

refund.title: Refund policy
refund.body:
If we cannot fulfil your order we refund the full amount within 24 hours.
Delivered digital products are non-refundable.
Electronics can be exchanged within 3 days if they arrive damaged.

delivery.title: Delivery policy
delivery.body:
Digital products (top-ups, coins, accounts): instant delivery worldwide once payment is confirmed.
Electronics: delivery within Somalia — 1–2 days in Mogadishu, 2–4 days elsewhere.
